content: Iñaaventaitziro kamaimetzinkaro ipoña kaariperori pinkathari
Ipoña joshiyakaaventanakero Jesús onkantya iramanayeetantyaarimi kitaiteriki, eero jovashaantayeetantaro.
Ikantzi: “Tzimatsi aparoni nampitsi, ari isaikiri kaariperori pinkathari, te iriñaapinkathateri irirori Pava, iri ovatsipero te iriñaapinkathateri atziri.
Ari osaikitari eejatzi aparoni tsinane kamaimetzinkaro. Opokashitakeri kaariperori pinkathari, okantziri: ‘Nokovi pinkaimenari kisaneentanari, povetsikainaro avishimotanari.’
Teya inkovavetya pinkatharika. Ipoña ikantashiretake: ‘Te noñaapinkathateri Pava, eejatzi nokempitairi atziri.
Iro kantacha iroka kamaimetzinkaro, ontzimatye nantenero kameethari okoviri. Nosamarokari aririka oñaashirenkena ompipiyatashitena.’”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Piñaakero ikantashiretakeri kaariperori pinkathari.
Iri maperotzirori Pava irirori, eero ishenkaatsi irantaineri kameethari ikoyaayetairi, tsika itzimi aakoventanaarori jamanairi kitaiteriki.”
Eekero ikantatzi Jesús: “Eerora ishenkaita irantantaityaarori kameethari. Iro kantacha aririka impiyapaake Itomi Atziri, ¿eekeroma iriñaapaatye aventaapiintyaarine kipatsiki?”
Joshiyakaaventaitziri Fariseo ipoña kovakotziri kireeki isheninka
Tzimayetatsi pampithashiretachari kameethashire inatzi. Ipoña imanintashirevaitziri pashine atziri. Irootake Jesús joshiyakaaventantanakariri, ikantzi:
“Tzimatsi apite atziri jiyaatake tasorentsipankoki iramane. Fariseo inatzi aparoni, iriima pashine iri kovakotziriri kireeki isheninka.

Ikanta ikatziyapaaka Fariseo jamani, ikantzi: ‘Pava, iniroite nopaasoonketzimi, tema te nokempitari naaka pashine atziri, koshintzi ini, kaariperoshire ikanta, mayempiri ini, ari ikempitakari irika kovakotziriri kireeki isheninka.
Apitesatzi notzitapiintaro novarite avisayetzira kitaite jimakoryaantaitari, nookapiintzi kireeki ikaratzi ipinaitanari.’

Ipoña irirori kovakotziriri kireeki isheninka, ikatziyapaaka jantyaatziini, oyootapaaka jamani te iramene jenoki. Tema okatsitzimoshiryaanakeri, ikantzi: ‘Pava, pinkaminthayena naaka, kaariperoshire nonatzi.’”

Ikantzi Jesús: “Iriitake jaakameethayeetairi irika, kameethashire ikanta jiyaatai ipankoki, te inkempityaari pashine. Tema tsikarika itzimi iriiperovaitatsiri iroñaaka, ari intsinampashiretakaitairi. Iriima tsika itzimi tsinampashirevaitatsiri iroñaaka, ari iriñeero iririiperotakaitairi.”
Itasonkaventziri Jesús eentsipayeeni
Ipoña jamayeetapaakeneri Jesús eenchaaniki, ikovaitzi irantantavakyaari kapicheeni irako. Iro kantacha iriyotaanera Jesús, ikisathatavakeri amayetziriri eentsi.
Irojatzi ikantantanakari Jesús: “Pishineteri eenchaaniki impokashitena. Eero pithañaana. Tema inkarate kempitaiyaarine irirori, iriitakera ñaagairone ipinkathariventantai Pava.
Omaperora, eerorika iñaapinkathaitziri Pava inkempitakoityaari ikantara eentsipayeeni, eero iñeetairo ipinkatharitai.”
Evankari ashaarantachari
Ikanta aparoni pinkathari josampitakeri Jesús, ikantziri: “Kameethari Iyotaantanerí, ¿opaitama nanteri noñaantaiyaarori kantaitaachaneri añaantarentsi?”
Ipoña jakanake Jesús, ikantzi: “¿Opaitaka pikantantanari: ‘kameethari pini?’ Apanirora ikantakaaro Pava ikameethatzi, tekatsi pashine.
Piyotakotakeroma Ikantakaantaitane, kantatsiri: Eero povantzi, eero pimayempitzi, eero pikoshitzi, eero pithaiyakotanta, eero pamatavitantzi, piñaapinkathateri ashitamiri.”
Ari jakanake evankari, ikantzi: “Iyotaantanerí, nothotyaakero maaroni irojatzi netanakaro pairani eeniro neentsitapaakeni.”

Ikanta ikemakerira, ikantzi Jesús: “Tzimatsi aparoni kovityaapainchari kaari pante. Pimpimantero okaratzi pashitari, pimpashiyetyaari ashinonkaachari. Tema ari piñagairo panintagaiya inkiteki. Impoña pimpokanake, poyaatena.”
Ikanta ikemavakera, ovashire ikantanaka, tema ashaarantaperoneri jinatzi.
Tema iñaakerira Jesús iniroite jovashiretanaka, ikantanake: “¡Omapero opomerentsita iriyaatai ashaarantzinkari tsika impinkatharitai Pava!
Tema eero okantzi inkye piratsi camello imoroki kithapi, iro ovatsipero ompomerentsitya inkye ashaarantzinkari tsika ipinkatharitai Pava.”
Ikantayetanake ikaratzi kemakeriri ikantake Jesús: “¿Impaityaakama avisakoshiretaatsine?”
Ipoña ikantzi Jesús: “Tzimatsi opaiyeta pomerentsitzimoyetariri atziri, iriima Pava te opomerentsitzimotari.”
Ari ikantanake Pedro: “Jirika nokarataiyakeni naaka, nookayetanakero okaratzi tzimimoyetanari, noyaataiyakemi.”
Ikantanake Jesús: “Omaperora, tzimatsirika kovanairori impinkathariventairi Pava, irootake jookaventantanakarori ipanko, ashitariri, irirentzi, iina, ipoña irovaiyaneete,
tema osheki impayetairiri Pava irika, ari anaanakero okaratzi jookaventanakeri. Ari inkempitagairiri eejatzi apaata aririka iriñeero kantaitaachaneri añaantarentsi.”
Japiitairo Jesús ikamantakota irovamagaiteri

Ipoña Jesús japatotairi karatatsiri 12 iriyotaane, ikantziri: “Aatatyeera iroñaaka Jerusalén-ki. Ari omonkaratyaari onkarate avishimoterine Itomi Atziri, tema irootake josankinatakoyetakeriri pairani kamantantaneri.
Arira iraakaantaiteri, irayeri atziri kaari asheninkata. Iniroite ishirontzimentavaitaityaari, inkemaantsitakaityaari, impoña inchoontaporovaitaiteri.
Aririka onkaratake impasavaitaiteri, ari irovamagaiteri. Iro avisavetakya mava kitaite, ari irañagai eejatzi.”
Iro kantamaitacha, te inkemathatero irikapayeeni ikaratzi kemavetainchari, tema te inkovaite inkemathatakagaiteri.
Jamenakagaitairi Jericó-satzi
Ikanta Jesús areetzimataka nampitsiki Jericó. Ari isaikiya aparoni mavityaakiri avotsinampiki ikampitantzi impashiityaari.
Ikemake mavityaakiri, josampitakeri avisayetatsiri atziri, ikantziri: “¿Ipaita pokatsiri?”
Ikantaitanakeri: “Ipokatzi Jesús, ipaitaitziri Nazaret-satzi.”
Irojatzi ikaimantanakari, ikantzi: “¡Jesús, icharinentari David-ni, pineshinonkataina naaka!”
Osheki ikisathaveetanakari irimairetantyaari. Eekero ikaimanakitzi shintsiini, ikantzi: “¡Icharinentari David-ni, pineshinonkataina naaka!”
Ari ikatziyapaaka Jesús, ikantzi: “Pamakenari jaka.” Ikanta jamaitapaakeneri, josampitavakeri.
Ikantziri: “¿Tsikama pikovi nonkantaimi?” Jakanake mavityaakiri, ikantzi: “Nokovi nokiryagai, Pinkatharí.”
Ikantzi Jesús: “Kantatsi pokiryagai, iro ovashinchagaimi paventaana.”
Omapokashitanaka jamenanai, joyaatanakeri Jesús, kimoshire ikantaventanakari Pava. Ikanta atziriite iñaakero okaratzi jantakeri Jesús, jimatanakero iriroriite itharomentaventanakari Pava.

footnotes.text: 18.13 Kantakotachari jaka “okatsitzimoshiryaanakeri,” iroora kantakotajaantachari jomposashipaneetanakitya irika atziri. Tema irootake jametayetari judío-payeeni aririka onkatsitzimoshireteri tsikarika ompaitya. Onashitara okaratzi ametari aakapayeeni aririka amposashipaneetya, tema asagaaventavaitatya.
